_about: Manufacturer-published values used by V10. Only values read from a cited source are entered. 'datasheet_points' is EMPTY for every product: iGuzzini publishes no per-code data sheet for Laser Evo codes at a public URL (iguzzini.com/<code> returns 404; the cdn5.iguzzini.com PDF was unreachable from the workstation, 2026-11-21). Fill it from the iGuzzini product selector PDF (illuminance cone, beam diameter, UGR) and V10 will check each point at +/-5 %.
